haunted-one.summary: Something terrible in your past, one horror or many, follows you everywhere; no blade or spell can drive it off, yet you keep going.

investigator.summary: Driven by a mystery you witnessed or by a hunger for justice, you dig into crimes and conspiracies others want buried.

mist-wanderer.summary: The Mists swept you from your homeland into the Domains of Dread, and you now drift between them seeking a way back, finding kinship with other lost travelers.

spirit-medium.summary: Rites or chance revealed you as a vessel for the dead, whose glimpses of what's to come carry a price and not always kind intent.
